head: 50386085b2e99a0f625e5e47ba370cdbab780e37
title: fix(money): truthful Stripe setup and real package billing views (T4)
body:
## MONEY-CONNECT-124 — agent 124 (T4)

### Normal-use blockers fixed
- **B-CONNECT-1:** A coach opens Settings > Payouts with Stripe details due but reads “Payouts active” and “Identity verified.” The screen now reuses the setup panel's live requirement/deadline copy and says “Details submitted,” not identity verified.
- **B-CONNECT-2:** A coach completes Stripe from Settings > Payouts and the ordinary browser sheet lacks the app's established return/refresh flow. This entry now uses the existing authenticated browser-return panel and live status refresh, the same flow as coach setup.
- **B-PACKAGE-2 (mobile half):** A coach opens real purchase rows with states such as `paid` or `granted`, which were absent from the screen's status table and could crash rendering. The API now adapts the real snake-case purchase page, all ordinary purchase states, client names, access/renewal state and currency. A purchase price is labeled “Package price,” never an invented lifetime paid total. Missing aggregate data is “Not available,” not zero. Additional pages remain reachable.
- **B-PACKAGE-3:** A quarterly package's three months were rendered as three quarters and could roundtrip as nine months. UI quarters now count quarters; the backend write still bills three months. Other monthly counts remain monthly.
- **B-PACKAGE-4:** A coach edits a GBP/CAD/etc. package and the editor labels its retained currency USD. The label now names the actual package currency.
- **B-PAYOUT-1:** A coach with no Stripe payout scheduled gets a made-up first-payout timing promise. Money now directs the coach to the real Stripe balance and payout schedule without inventing an arrival date.
- **U-PACKAGE-1:** Archive copy now distinguishes archive from taking a package off sale. The management catalog requests archived rows, and raw mutation replies no longer erase measured client counts/MRR.

### Proof and pairing
- `src/__tests__/moneyConnect124.test.tsx`: rendered Settings onboarding/requirements, actual subscriber states/currency, quarterly roundtrip, editor currency and archived catalog.
- `src/screens/coach/money/__tests__/money.test.tsx`: no invented first-payout timing.
- Existing API request expectations updated for `include_archived=true`.
- Targeted actual-module checks fail on unchanged main and pass on this implementation; source-wiring checks supplement the rendered regressions. PR CI remains the proof.
- Backend companion provides real package counts/MRR, safe client names and exact pricing-lock state. Deploy that read-contract change before relying on the added statistics; this mobile version shows unavailable data honestly until then.

### Boundaries
- No purchase rules, billing writes, fee math, native modules, workflows, schema, lockfiles, store checkout policy or feature flags changed.
- No production/provider calls, merge, deployment, CI cancellation, secrets or spend.

Recommended defaults: create a new package for new prices; use “Take off sale” to stop new sales; Stripe's dashboard is the authority for payout schedule and actual bank arrival estimates.
